newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-ITALY NAME BERTOLUCCI AS DAVIS CUP CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ITALY NAME BERTOLUCCI AS DAVIS CUP CAPTAIN.

text.p: Italy named Paolo Bertolucci as their new Davis Cup tennis captain on Sunday.
Bertolucci, three times a Davis Cup finalist, takes over from Adriano Panatta, who resigned late last month after a contractual row with Paolo Galgani, president of the Italian Tennis Federation.
The feud prompted the Italian players, who pledged their loyalty to Panatta, to consider pulling out of the competition.
Galgani was heavily criticised for his management style in the wake of the row and earlier this month announced that he too would step down in November after 20 years at the helm.
Bertolucci, 46, will captain the Italians in their Davis Cup semifinal against Sweden on September 19-21, a reward for their shock 4-1 defeat of Spain in the quarter-finals.
The winners will meet either Australia or the United States in the final.
"Galgani wishes to thank Bertolucci for the sensitivity he has shown and for his loyalty to the Azzurri in this delicate moment for Italian tennis," the federation said in a statement.
